notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q3891623_palacio_de_velazquez.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Outline from OpenStreetMap; the roof layout from the PNOA orthophoto: the north–south glass barrel vault over the central hall (17 m span, to about 21.9 m), three east–west metal barrel vaults with glazed strips on each wing, four corner pavilions with metal cloister vaults and a skylight, a flat terrace with skylights along the north. Heights measured on photos (±8 %): wing cornice 10.5 m, central pylons 13 m with a balustrade, pavilions 12.5 m. The brickwork is drawn as alternating red and buff bands; Zuloaga's tiles as a blue frieze under the cornices and blue/white panels round the pavilion arches; the triple-arched porticos (south with its stair and two stylised winged lions, north on its forecourt) are simplified, and the window rhythm of the wings is regular (3.2 m bays), not the real one. Uncertain: the exact division of the wing vaults, the interior walls (not modelled), the vault heights (±1 m).
